title: LandlordGuard Deductible Options — Desk Quick Reference
content:
Deductible choices available on each LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy tier. The all-other-perils deductible is a flat amount; the wind/hail deductible is chosen as a percentage of Coverage A.

| | DP-1 Basic | DP-2 Broad | DP-3 Special | DP-3 Special Plus | DP-3 Premier | DP-3 Portfolio |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| All-other-perils deductibles (USD) | 1,000 / 2,500 | 1,000 / 2,500 / 5,000 | 1,000 / 2,500 / 5,000 | 1,000 / 2,500 / 5,000 | 2,500 / 5,000 / 10,000 | 2,500 / 5,000 / 10,000 |
| Wind/hail deductible (percent of Coverage A) | 1 / 2 | 1 / 2 | 1 / 2 | 1 / 2 | 1 / 2 | 1 / 2 / 5 |

Plain figures: all-other-perils deductibles of 1000, 2500, 5000 and 10000 USD as listed per tier; wind/hail percentages of 1, 2 and, on LandlordGuard DP-3 Portfolio only, 5.

**Notes on the card**

- A deductible of 5,000 USD is not offered on LandlordGuard DP-1 Basic; 10,000 USD is offered only on DP-3 Premier and DP-3 Portfolio, and 1,000 USD is not offered on those two tiers.
- A 5 percent wind/hail deductible exists only on LandlordGuard DP-3 Portfolio.
- Hypothetical illustration: on Coverage A of 250,000 USD, a 2 percent wind/hail choice is 2 percent of 250,000 USD, that is 5,000 USD.
